empty.projectsHint: A project carries the style its sprites are drawn to. Create one to start.
empty.assetsHint: A sprite is created at a fixed size, because every layer and every recorded edit is measured in it.

form.eraHint: Sets the palette ceiling, the ramp bounds and the outline rule every sprite in the project is checked against: 8-bit is 4 colours, 16-bit 16, 32-bit 24. It cannot be changed afterwards.
form.proportionsHint: Chibi suits big-head characters with small raised details, and loosens the silhouette checks. It cannot be changed afterwards.
form.lineHint: Derived colours the outline from the fills beside it, after light. Single colour draws one line colour right after the silhouette, then flats, shadow and light inside it, the way a one-colour line sprite is drawn by hand.
form.viewHint: Sets the proportions and the default sprite sizes. Top-down is taller than wide; side-view is squarer, facing right. It cannot be changed afterwards.
form.sizeHint: Taken from the project's era and view, for the kind you chose. A sprite cannot be resized later, so this is the one number worth getting right now.

confirm.deleteProjectBody: This deletes the project and every sprite in it. For each sprite it deletes every layer, the palette, and the whole edit log, which is what undo reads from. There is nothing left to undo it with afterwards.
confirm.deleteAssetBody: This deletes the sprite, every layer it has, its palette, and its whole edit log, which is what undo reads from. There is nothing left to undo it with afterwards.

toast.loadFailed: The projects could not be read.
toast.createProjectFailed: The project could not be created.
toast.renameProjectFailed: The project could not be renamed.
toast.deleteProjectFailed: The project could not be deleted.
toast.createAssetFailed: The sprite could not be created.
toast.renameAssetFailed: The sprite could not be renamed.
toast.deleteAssetFailed: The sprite could not be deleted.
